BETA Close X Pets at Home Group Plc announced that between June 29 and July 3, 2026, it purchased 986,983 ordinary shares as part of its share buyback program, with prices ranging from 175.3 GBp to 183.6 GBp. Following these purchases, the company's total issued ordinary shares will be 446,865,575, with no shares held in treasury, resulting in a total of 446,865,575 voting rights. Disclaimer* Pets At Home Group Plc 06 July 2026 06 July 2026 Pets at Home Group Plc Transaction in Own Shares Pets at Home Group Plc (the "Company"), announces that, in the period Monday 29 June 2026 to Friday 03 July 2026, it purchased in aggregate 986,983 of its ordinary £0.01 shares ("Ordinary Shares") through Deutsche Bank AG, London Branch (trading for these purposes as Deutsche Numis) ("Deutsche Numis"), in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme announced on 24 June 2026 ("Share Buyback Programme"). Date Aggregate Volume Lowest price paid (GBp) Highest price paid (GBp) Weekly weighted Average Price paid per share (GBp) 29/06/2026 200,000 177.8 181.0 179.7373 30/06/2026 200,000 176.6 180.8 178.7986 01/07/2026 200,000 175.3 179.7 177.4777 02/07/2026 186,983 178.9 181.9 180.5523 03/07/2026 200,000 180.4 183.6 182.1243 The purchased shares will be cancelled. Following the purchase of these shares, the remaining number of Ordinary Shares in issue will be 446,865,575 with no shares held in treasury. Therefore, the total voting rights in the Company will be 446,865,575 . This figure for the total number of voting rights may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
